old: Who's there?
new: What's with this guy!?
jp: な、何？　こいつ！？
reason: JP 'こいつ!?' refers to someone already present (Fei, whose strange behavior the next lines react to), not an unknown newcomer; 'Who's there?' changes what she is reacting to.

old:
village. Everyone there
treated me like family.
new:
village. They treated me,
an outsider, like family.
jp: 村のみんなは、よそ者の俺にも家族同然に接してくれた。
reason: JP stresses that the villagers treated Fei, an outsider (よそ者), like family; the outsider detail about his origins is dropped.

old: a hail of bullets...
new:
a stray bullet...
Everything went white...
jp: 流れ弾にやられたんだ……。俺は目の前が真っ白になって……
reason: Timothy was hit by a stray bullet (流れ弾), not targeted, and the last line 'everything went white before my eyes', which leads into his blackout, is missing.

old:
I didn't realize my own
strength
new:
I didn't know my own
limits
jp: 自分の力量も知らないで、結果を他人のせいにして
reason: 自分の力量も知らないで means not knowing his own limits (overreaching); 'didn't realize my own strength' suggests the opposite, that he was too strong.

old:
It is rumored they are
here solely to get the
resources in the ruins.
new:
It is rumored they are
active worldwide, seeking
resources in the ruins.
jp: うわさでは彼等も遺跡資源を獲得する為に世界規模で活動しているということです。
reason: JP says Geburah reportedly operates on a worldwide scale to obtain ruin resources, not that they are 'here solely' for them.

old:
It must be to suppress the
recent border skirmishes.
new:
This is becoming more than
mere border skirmishes.
jp: これは国境付近の小競り合いだけでは済まされなくなってきたな。
reason: JP: this can no longer stay at the level of skirmishes near the border (escalation), not that the ship is there to suppress them.

old:
Judging from your uniform,
I would also say you are
with the Geburah military.
Perhaps a lieutenant...
new:
And judging from your
uniform, you are clearly
with the military...
jp: 加えてその格好、どう見たって軍備のものですよ……
reason: Citan only says her outfit is obviously military; naming Geburah and guessing her rank are additions (he explains the uniform/ID-tag link in the next lines).

old:
So... I called Fei a
coward for just wanting
to escape his own burden
of responsibility.
new:
So... I called Fei a
coward, just because I
wanted to escape my own
burden of responsibility.
jp: それで私、自分が責任の重圧から逃れたいばっかりにフェイに臆病だって言ってしまったんです。
reason: Elly confesses that SHE wanted to escape the weight of her own responsibility and so called Fei a coward; PW makes it Fei's escape, inverting her guilt.

old:
to the Church, they've been
running around like fools...
new:
to the Church HQ, we've been
run off our feet...
jp: 『教会』本部があんなことになってしまったから、もうテンテコまいだよ。
reason: JP: since that happened to Church headquarters, we (this workshop) have been swamped; PW says 'they' have been running around like fools.

old:
I'm gonna have to
cooperate with the
surviving mechanics.
new:
From now on, the surviving
branches are gonna have
to work together.
jp: これからは生き残った支部同士で協力し合って頑張らないとな。
reason: JP refers to the surviving Church branches (支部) cooperating with each other after the HQ disaster, not to surviving mechanics.

old: become so lively.
new: become so militarized.
jp: 最近はこの街もものものしくなってきたからのぉ。
reason: ものものしい means heavily guarded/tense (soldiers everywhere), not 'lively'; that is why seeing the children happy is a relief.

old:
We need the army because they
get us generators from the
Gears found in the ruins.
new:
To build up our forces, we
need generators from the
Gears found in the ruins.
jp: 軍備を整えるには、遺跡からギアを掘り出し、ジェネレーターを回収する必要があるからな。
reason: JP: to build up the military we need to dig Gears out of the ruins and recover their generators; PW reverses cause and effect.

old:
<Weltall> was made by the
Kislev Army, so we can
most likely recover the
part from Kislev Gears."
new:
(<Weltall> was made by
the Kislev Army, so we can
most likely recover the
part from Kislev Gears.)"
jp: （それに、ヴェルトールはキスレブ軍が作ったギアです。きっと、キスレブ製のギアから必要な部品を回収できますよ。
reason: In JP this page is a parenthesized aside (whispered so the rental clerk doesn't hear Weltall is Kislev-made), matching Fei's parenthesized whisper in block 7.

old:
Lots of fights break out
in the desert... It's a
real dangerous place.
new:
The fighting in the desert
may be dying down, but it's
still a dangerous place.
jp: 沙漠での紛争がおさまりつつある、といっても、危険な場所であることに變わりないよ。
reason: JP: even though the conflict in the desert is subsiding, it's still dangerous; PW says fights break out a lot (reversed).

old: Small Sensor
new: Medium Sensor
jp: 中型センサー
reason: The rental list item is a medium-sized sensor (中型), listed as 'Small Sensor'.

old:
I'll have to go home a
failure. What should I do?
new:
I can't go back home till
I strike it rich. What
should I do?
jp: 一山あてない事には田舎にも帰れないし。どうしよう……
reason: JP: he can't go back home to the countryside without striking it rich; PW says he'll have to go home a failure, the opposite situation.

old:
If you didn't understand
that, I'll repeat...
new:
If you can't know what's
coming, then don't...
jp: 先の事なんかわかんねえなら最初から……ウィッ！　最初から色々と物事を決めてかかんねえ事だ。
reason: JP: 'if you can't know the future, then from the start... *hic* don't go deciding things from the start'; there is no 'if you didn't understand, I'll repeat'.

old: Bah!
new: Eek!
jp: ひいぃっ！
reason: ひいぃっ is a frightened shriek (from the hunter who just said Big Joe looks dangerous), not a dismissive 'Bah!'.

old:
Our workshop can hardly keep
up with the demand for repairs
on the worker Gears used in
the excavation of the ruins.
new:
So it was always enough
for our workshop to repair
the worker Gears used in
the excavation of the ruins.
jp: この工房も、発掘作業用のギアを修理できるだけで十分だったのです。
reason: JP: it was enough for this workshop to only repair excavation worker Gears (why it can't handle military parts); PW says it can barely keep up with demand.

old:
Hurry and
do what...?
new: No, but...
jp: いや、でも……
reason: Fei is reluctant to pilot Weltall again ('No, but...'), which Citan then answers; PW turns it into confusion about what to hurry for.

old: I don't...<Delay 15>know who I am.
new: I...<Delay 15>want to know who I am.
jp: 俺は……自分が何者なのか知りたい。
reason: JP: 'I want to know who I am', the new desire he contrasts with never having questioned himself; PW only states that he doesn't know.

old: Amazing...!
new: Just as I thought...
jp:
ほう……？
やはり……
reason: やはり means 'just as I thought', not 'amazing'; Citan is confirming a suspicion about the Gear acting on its own, which hints at his foreknowledge.

old: Ol' man Bal
new: Ol' Man Bal
jp: バル爺
reason: Speaker name is capitalised 'Ol' Man Bal' everywhere else in the file.

old: is up to something!
new: is onto something!
jp:
いや、きっとあの爺さんは
手がかりつかんでたり……
reason: Bart says the old man has probably got hold of a clue (to the ancient Gears), not that he is scheming.

old:
northwest of where my
repair robot stands.
new:
northwest of where the
Gear I serviced stands.
jp:
わしの整備したギアがいた所を
北西に進んでいくと
reason: JP says 'where the Gear I serviced is'; there is no repair robot. It is the well-maintained abandoned Gear Bart remarks on in 0736 block 9.

old:
They found her crying in
the desert.<Delay 10> They brought
her here in the Yggdrasil.
new:
The Yggdrasil found her
crying in the desert.<Delay 10>

jp:
沙漠で泣いてるとこを
ユグドラシルでひろったんだ。
まだ慣れなくってずっとああさ。
reason: The line explaining why the girl behaves as she does (she still hasn't got used to it, so she's always like that) was dropped.

old:
I was wondering when
you'd show up!
new:
I always knew you'd
pull it off someday!
jp:
あたしゃ、いつかやってくれると
思ってたよ！
reason: She is praising Bart's success ('I always knew you'd pull it off someday'), not remarking on him arriving late.

old:
However, in reality, we
rescued the young Prince
from Shakhan's evil grasp.
new:
But in truth, Shakhan seized
power after the King died,
and imprisoned the Prince.
It was we who rescued him.
jp:
ですが真相は違うのです。
若は、王亡き後
アヴェの実権を握った
シャーカーンによって
幽閉されていたのです。
その若を我々がお救いしたので
ございます。
reason: JP states that after the King's death Shakhan took real power in Av and imprisoned the Prince; PW reduces this to 'evil grasp' and loses both facts.

old:
that is drawn in one of
the Av picture scrolls.
new:
that is drawn in one of
the picture scrolls of
Av's founding.
jp:
実はな、アヴェ建国の絵巻物の中に
それらしい描写があるんだ。
reason: JP specifies the scrolls depict Av's founding, which sets up the Fatima I scroll shown next.

old: it was our
new: it was my
jp: オイラのイビキかと思った。
reason: オイラ is singular: the speaker thought it was his own snoring.

old:
Edbart IV, was betrayed
by Shakhan.
new:
Edbart IV, was assassinated
by Shakhan.
jp:
シャーカーンに暗殺された
って言われてんだ。
reason: 暗殺された means 'was assassinated'; 'betrayed' loses the claim that Shakhan killed the King.

old:
I can't let the Young
Master see me like this.
new:
I'm setting a bad example
for the young'uns.
jp: 若い衆にシメシがつかねぇぜ。
reason: 若い衆 are the young crewmen, not the Young Master (若); he is worried about setting a bad example for them.

old:
model Gear and two people
that we helped out.
new:
model Gear and two people
who'll be helping us.
jp:
新型のギア一機に
助っ人二人ってとこかな。
reason: 助っ人 means helpers/reinforcements; Bart presents Fei and Citan as new help, not as people they rescued.

old: What's that?
new: Ha ha, just kidding!
jp: ナンチャッテ！
reason: ナンチャッテ is a playful 'just kidding!' after the kid parodies the item-get message; 'What's that?' makes no sense here.

old: don't you have to fight?
new:
don't you have to put an
end to all this conflict?
jp:
争いはなくさなくちゃ
いけないんじゃないのか？
reason: Bart says that to atone, Fei must help eliminate conflict, not simply 'fight'; this matches his argument about removing the cause of war.

old:
But<Delay 10> if I had your skill
I could bring all of
this to an end<Delay 5>...
new:
But<Delay 10> I figured with skill
like yours, you could face
up to that reality<Delay 5>...
jp:
ただな、俺は、お前程の腕があれば
その現実と对決出来ると……
村の子供達にも罪滅ぼし出来ると、
そう思ったんだがな……。
reason: Bart thought that FEI, with his skill, could confront that reality and atone to the village kids; PW makes it Bart's ability, which makes the following 'make it up to those kids' illogical.

old:
Ignore those! We can
take them out fast.
new:
Look! They're rushing out
half-prepared!
jp:
見なよ。
やつら、押っ取り刀で
駆けつけてきたみたいだよぉ。
reason: Franz says 'Look, they've come rushing over in a hurry'; nothing about ignoring them or taking them out fast.

old:
Why not take a few?<Delay 10>
Even if we only get those,
it was worth sneaking in.
new:
Suits me.<Delay 10>
Otherwise sneaking in
wouldn't be worth it.
jp:
いいじゃねぇか。
そうでなければわざわざ侵入した
甲斐がない。
reason: Strachey welcomes the pirates coming out: otherwise sneaking in would have been pointless. PW's 'take a few / only get those' is not in the JP.

old:
Shush!<Delay 10>
Spirale is now in
place at the back!
new:
Alright!<Delay 10>
Spirale, stand by
at the rear!
jp:
ようし！
シュピラーレは後方で待機！
reason: ようし is 'Alright!', not 'Shush!', and Rank is ordering Spirale to stand by at the rear, not reporting it.

old: what're you doing!?
new: what're you on about!?
jp:
こ、こいつ、
何言ってやがる！？
reason: 何言ってやがる is 'what are you saying/talking about', reacting to Fei's questions, not to an action.

old:
What if this was 
your home!?
new:
Does it give you a
place to belong!?
jp:
自分の居場所が
あるっていうのか！！
reason: Fei asks whether fighting gives them a place to belong (居場所), echoing his 'my place to belong' monologue in 0764; 'What if this was your home' changes the meaning.

old:
Looks like someone really
knew how to tune up your
Gear...
new:
I've been tinkering with
your Gear in all sorts
of ways...
jp: お前さんのギア、いろいろといじってみたんだが……。
reason: The mechanic says he himself has been tinkering with Fei's Gear in various ways; PW wrongly says someone else tuned it well.

old:
However, when Sigurd was
telling his story I thought
it was best to stay quiet.
new:
However, when Sigurd
confided in me, I too felt
it best to stay quiet.
jp: しかし、シグルド殿に打ち明けられたときには、私も黙っているべきだと思ったのです。
reason: Mason means that when Sigurd confided in him (in the past), he too decided to keep quiet; PW implies Mason stayed quiet during the story just told.

old:
Since long ago, the Nisan
mothers and the kings of
Av have always<-->
new:
Since long ago, the Holy
Mothers of Nisan and the
kings of Av have always<-->
jp: いにしえよりニサン教の教母様とアヴェの国王であられる方とは……
reason: 教母様 is the title 'Holy Mother' per Script-Changes (title for the latter-day leaders of Nisan); 'the Nisan mothers' loses the title.

old:
Could you go to that
inn across the way?
new:
Have you been to the
inn across the way?
jp: 向かいの宿は行かれました？
reason: The JP asks whether they have been to the inn across the way (and says they'll be treated well there); PW turns it into a request.

old:
They're imported
through kidnapping,
and then used as
manual labor.
new:
They use them as
manual labor to keep
their nation running.
jp: 国外の人間を『ラムズ』と呼び……、自らの国家運営の労働力として使っていました。
reason: JP only says Solaris uses outsiders as labor to run its nation; 'imported through kidnapping' is not in the line (Sigurd's own abduction is stated separately in block 76).

old:
Were you...
slaves to that
son of a...?
new:
Is that where you
met that son of a...?
jp: あの野郎とはそこで出会ったのか。
reason: Bart asks whether that is where they met that bastard (Ramsus), not whether they were his slaves; Citan's reply (block 55) confirms it.

old: Well, not exactly.
new: Well, more or less.
jp: まあ、そんなところです。
reason: まあ、そんなところです = 'Well, something like that', an affirmative; PW reverses the polarity.

old:
...<Delay 30>You were
friends with
these people?
new:
...<Delay 30>So you were
one of them?
jp: ……奴等の仲間だったってのか。
reason: 奴等の仲間 = 'one of them / on their side'; Bart is reacting to Sigurd having been part of the Solaris government, not having been friends.

old:
...<Delay 30>There's nothing I
can do about that now.
new:
...<Delay 30>I have no excuse
to offer for that.
jp: ……その事に関しては、もはや弁解のしようがありません。
reason: Sigurd says he has no excuse/defense to offer on that point (an apology), not that nothing can be done about it.

old:
I was used as a test
subject. There was
probably something they
valued inside of me.
new:
I was abducted to Solaris
as a test subject. There
was probably something
they valued inside of me.
jp: ソラリスに被験体としてら致されたのです。恐らくはこの私の中に…
reason: JP states Sigurd was abducted to Solaris as a test subject; PW omits the abduction, a key plot fact.

old:
He became the commander
after leaving there.
new:
He was commissioned as
an officer after leaving.
jp: 彼はそこを出た後、任官しました。
reason: 任官 = received his commission/appointment as an officer; he did not become commander straight out of Jugend (Citan then explains his rapid rise).

old: What's he up to?
new: What do we do?
jp: どうする？
reason: Fei asks what they should do, prompting Bart's 'We have to go!'; PW changes it to a question about Shakhan's intent.

old: this place..."
new: this place...
jp: ここへ攻め込んでくる用意はしているのではないかと……。
reason: Stray closing quote on an unnamed (no speaker) line with no opening quote.

old:
...I think that's what
it was.
new:
...Or maybe it was more
of an ornament.
jp: 船のオモチャだよ……というか置物だったかな。
reason: Bart corrects himself: it may have been an ornament rather than a toy (the joke being he 'borrowed' shop merchandise); PW drops this.

old:
think he could strike
our Gear forces?
new:
think our Gear forces
can take them down?
jp: で、先生から見て、そいつらは俺達のギア部隊でも叩けるのか？
reason: Bart asks whether their Gear units can defeat the fleet; PW reverses who attacks whom.

old:
Even with Vanderkam, we
have enough forces left
to pull off the feint.<New>
However, it would not be
wise to underestimate our
opponents.
new:
Vanderkam aside, even if
the feint goes as planned,
there should still be
ample forces at home.<New>
In that sense, we cannot
afford to be optimistic.
jp: ただしヴァンダーカムはさておき、うまくこちらの思惑通りに陽動出来たとしても、本国には充分な戦力が残っているはずです。その意味では、樂観視はできませんけどね。
reason: Citan warns that even if the diversion works, the home country will still retain ample forces, so optimism is unwarranted; PW says 'we' have enough forces left.

old:
There's no way we
can lose!
new:
Anyway, no reckless
moves we can't win!
jp: とにかく勝ち目のない無茶はなしだ！
reason: Bart forbids reckless actions with no chance of winning; PW turns it into a boast that they can't lose.

old: The holy mothers and
new: The Holy Mothers and
jp: 歴代の教母様とアヴェの国王様がまつられているんだ。
reason: 'Holy Mother' is the capitalized title for Nisan's leaders per Script-Changes.

old:
Dad's will was there,
too, although that was
kept pretty quiet...
new:
I kept it quiet from
everyone, because of
Dad's dying wishes...
jp: 親父の遺言もあったし、みんなには黙ってたんだが……
reason: Bart kept the Treasure's location secret from everyone, partly because of his father's will; PW says the will itself was in the mausoleum.

old: Church are not holy.
new: Church are not holy men.
jp: 厳密には『教会』の人間は聖職者じゃありません。管理者です。
reason: 聖職者 = clergy; Citan says Church members are not clergymen (answering Bart's 'holy man'), not that they are 'not holy'.

old: the Fatima Jasper as his
new: the Fatima Treasure as his
jp: おそらくシャーカーンはアヴェ王家の至宝を最後の切り札と考えているはず。
reason: The trump card is the royal family's Treasure (至宝), which Bart will keep from him; the Jasper is only the key to it.

some

reason: Trailing space at end of line.

reason: Trailing space at end of line.

jp: ただし……くれぐれもおいたをなさってはいけませんよ。

old:
a 
little

a

jp: 少しグッときちゃった。
reason: Trailing space at end of line.

them is the path from
where God advents...
new:
them is the path by

jp: そして、その間が神の降臨する道……

You miss the deeper meaning
and beauty of it!

jp: んもう、若はせっかちだなぁ！
reason: Margie calls Bart impatient (reacting to him finding it tiresome to fly in pairs); PW invents a different rebuke.

from

from

jp: こんなところへ来るとは若いのに関心じゃの。

reigns and eras.
new:

were led by two rulers:

jp: 御兄弟や御夫婦、お二人で国を栄えさせる御世《みよ》が多いのだとか。

new:

equipment ready.
jp: ただいま装備を整えています。
reason: JP says the crew is preparing the equipment right now. PW says everything is already ready.

jp: 一説では今から500年程前に描かれたものだと云われております。

jp: 一説では今から500年程前に描かれたものだと云われております。
reason: Same line as block 26: 500年程前 means 'about 500 years ago'.

happened to the Holy
Mother's remains...

happened to the late Holy

for them both.

the way those two are,
who can say?

shop owner was drafted
new:
